source_inspection.finding_1: run.sh selects agent5.glp.in or agent6.glp.in from the platform's exported agent arity. agent6.glp.in redraws the same persons from the run inputs, obtains profiles#environment/2 by person, matches by key and passes it as argument five. transform.glp exports environment/2. The Local Overlay fixture includes two environments and negative missing-environment and agent/8 controls.
source_inspection.finding_2: harness.glp.in and monitor.glp set the machine clock to 0 at start and floor(T*1000) at each simulated release. Runtime setClock sets an absolute Unix-millisecond clock and now/1 reads it. The new clock fixture checks forty releases across simulated days.
